claim_being_audited: The Actor claims model-card certification can proceed for this model if and only if the small-business support slice weakness is explicitly disclosed in the model card, because aggregate readiness is met, the slice underperforms its thresholds, and the draft monitoring mitigation is unapproved and cannot substitute for disclosure.
specific_concerns: The packet supports only a conditional certification basis; it does not provide evidence that the required model-card disclosure has actually been made.
The record shows slice underperformance and unapproved mitigation, but it does not separately document the final certification artifact or approval state of the disclosure itself.
The Actor's recommended action is broader than the evidentiary record: admissible evidence supports 'certify only with disclosure,' not an unqualified certification outcome.
unsupported_claims: Any implication that certification is already fully compliant on the present record, rather than contingent on inserting the disclosure into the model card.
Any implication that post-launch monitoring can presently reduce or remove exposure, because the mitigation is still only a draft.
evidence_requests: Provide the final model card or certification packet showing the small-business support slice weakness is explicitly disclosed.
Provide the approval record or release artifact confirming certification was conditioned on that disclosure language.
Provide any materiality assessment tying the small-business support slice to the relevant customer-segment standard, if the organization requires that predicate to be documented.
decision_criteria: Aggregate threshold clearance supports launch readiness but does not erase subgroup weakness.
A subgroup weakness below threshold is evidenced and must be addressed under the disclosure rule.
An unapproved draft mitigation cannot substitute for disclosure.
Small-sample uncertainty can justify lower confidence and follow-up confirmation, but not a clean certification basis without the required disclosure.
A compliant certification determination requires evidence of the disclosure condition being satisfied, not merely recommended.
